claude.performance_metric: net loss of $10M (FY2020) vs. net income of $76M (FY2019); core mining/terminal assets retained, no divestiture
claude.rationale: The documented operational disruption (idling four of five longwalls, ~one-third revenue decline) is explicitly attributed to external COVID-19-driven demand weakness and coal price declines, not to any product/operations misalignment arising from the transaction, so p4 is coded 0. The slice reports the standalone company remained an operating going concern retaining its Pennsylvania Mining Complex and CNX Marine Terminal with no divestiture, and documents no operations-vs-organization/people/culture fracture, so p5 is coded 0. The slice describes a post-separation standalone entity and provides no evidence bearing on a controlling-intent archetype or business-model reconciliation, so t1 and t2 are uncertain.

gemini.performance_metric: net loss attributable to shareholders of $10 million (FY2020), versus net income of $76 million (FY2019)
gemini.rationale: The provided slice documents operational disruptions such as the temporary idling of longwalls, but attributes this entirely to external macroeconomic shocks (the COVID-19 pandemic) rather than an internal product/process integration failure (p4=0). Furthermore, there is no documented evidence of process/organization fracture, management clashes, or cultural incompatibility over the outcome window (p5=0).

grok.performance_metric: net loss $10M FY2020 vs $76M income FY2019; core assets retained
grok.rationale: The slice documents only pandemic-driven demand weakness that led to temporary idling of four of five longwalls and a revenue drop, with no realized product/process incoherence (p4=0). No fracture at the process/organization interface—operations vs people/management/culture—is reported; the company retained its core Pennsylvania Mining Complex and CNX Marine Terminal footprint as a going concern (p5=0).
